name: v1 · 26 Oct design
summary: AF7, AF8, Fz, Pz. TP9 + TP10 linked as reference, Fpz ground. Saline sponge pods, forehead heart sensor. Includes AR and try-on.
status: Retired by D24 in the research plan

name: v2 · 29 Oct research plan
summary: Fp1, Fp2, Fz, Pz, TP10, eye (VEOG). TP9 reference alone, Fpz bias. Hydrogel on the forehead, semi-dry pods in hair, earlobe heart-sensor clip. Realistic 540 mm head with all 10-10 sites measured.

name: v3 · 29 Oct review
summary: Fp1, Fp2, Fz, Pz, M2, eye (VEOG). M1 mastoid-bone reference on SRB2, Fpz bias, gain 12. One snap socket per site with swappable inserts: paste on the forehead, semi-dry pods in hair. Test kit toggle adds ECG on channel 7 and dry comparison inserts.
status: Superseded by v4 (7 Nov product design)

name: v4 · 7 Nov product design
summary: The launch design (v4.4): a 5-minute in-clinic session at baseline, day 7 and every visit. Fp1, Fp2, Fz, Cz, Pz, M2, eye (VEOG); M1 reference, Fpz bias. Single-use hydrogel forehead strip placed by a nasion template, earlobe heart clip. Buildable frame for 500–580 mm circumference and 300–390 mm nasion–inion: bought ratchet harness with a 3 mm lining or 7 mm small-head insert, midline band 3D-printed in the head's curve with a TPU tail, spring-loaded semi-dry pods pinned at one size number (1–9); damp single-use foam tips with top-up drops when the app's wetting check asks. Main board (v4.5) in the brow module: the analog half of the open Low-Cost-EEG board plus a Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3. Session walkthrough, fit sliders, buy/print parts list.
status: Superseded by v6 (its midline band is kept)

name: v5 · arch concept (v5.2, 8 Nov)
summary: Same electronics and sites as v4.5, new frame: a spring arch over Cz, the main board in a pod above the left ear and the battery above the right, temple arms to soft pads, and a rear band with a hook under the occiput tightened by a dial. v5.2: Fz, Cz and Pz in spring carriages on a rigid spine clipped to the arch at Cz, one soft spring per pod. Forehead bare apart from the strip.

name: Ultracortex pod adapter · 8 Nov
summary: Holds a Neuryo semi-dry pod in an OpenBCI Ultracortex Mark IV frame node to test a rigid frame with a spring per pod before designing the v5 spine. Four print files: node ring (glued in place of the OpenBCI insert, M20 × 2), pod tube with knob, spring seat and pin slots, pod body with fill tube force mark, tip collar. Bought: 8 mm OD spring about 0.13 N/mm.

name: v6 · head ring + v4 midline · 8 Nov (v6.3, 11 Nov)
channels: 6 on the head + ECG test channel
summary: v4's midline band lying on the head with a spring carriage per pod (Fz and Pz at 0.2 and 0.6 × nasion–inion from Fpz, one size number 1–9), held between a small front anchor (about 34 × 34 × 7.5 mm, replacing v4's brow module) and a cam lock above the rear dial. Head ring: front band across the forehead above the strip, rear band with a hook under the occiput and a dial. Main board in a pod above the left ear, battery above the right (from v5). Real windows in the band and real lead slots in the carriages. v6.1 (9 Nov): the real rev B board, placed from KiCad (77 × 50 mm, electrode end forward), leads ending on its pads, pods resized to about 98 × 77 mm and 22 mm off the skin. v6.2 (10 Nov): carriages wrap the rails and click into size notches (they could lift off before), rails 3 mm thick beside the windows, Cz pod moved to the test kit (product: Fz and Pz). v6.3 (11 Nov): no Cz anywhere (decision D36); two windows in the band (Fz, Pz), two lead clips on the solid section between them, size table centred on 300–390 mm.
status: Superseded by v7 (kept for comparison; the adjustable-Fz alternative)

name: v7.1 · simplified ring and fixed Fz · 11 Nov
channels: 6 on the head + ECG test channel
summary: Proposed, from the 11 Nov design review of v6.3; nothing printed or measured. Same montage, electrodes, rev B board and firmware as v6.3. One continuous printed head ring strap from a pivot behind the left pod, across the forehead and under both pods (a tunnel in each pod's base, 2 × M3), with the PN521 nape section kept whole and pivoting on its ends; the pods carry no ring tension. Chin-strap tabs on the ring, the strap in the test kit. Side pods with a flat, chamfered face parallel to the board, 15.5 mm off the skin (was 22), JP1 and TP1 left off, 3.0 mm clearance rule; outer box about 106.7 × 69.0 × 25.7 mm, headset 180.4 mm wide (v6.3: 189.1). A clip-in nasion gauge sets the midline band's zero; the forehead strip goes on after the headset, from the anchor's pointer. Fz fixed at 69 mm behind the zero (up to 9 mm from its 10-20 site, the same spot every visit); only Pz has a size setting. Tail travel corrected to about 81 mm, pull tab with stretch marks, spare end folded in half under two keepers. v7.1 (same day): fixes from the review of v7, dark grey leads with colour end bands, and a Midline module toggle showing the forehead-only configuration (an option, not decided). v6 stays as the adjustable-Fz alternative.
status: Lead design (proposed; v6 kept as the adjustable-Fz alternative)
